name: The Pact of Five
description: The lore of the base game: the world of Valdren, its six peoples and their cultures, the seven callings, the Twelve Signs and everything a hero's life story touches.

world.title: The world
world.blurb: Valdren, the Underflame beneath it and the Hollows that break through.

era.title: History
era.blurb: The ages of Valdren, from the Dawnfire to the Waking.

place.title: Places
place.blurb: Lands, cities and roads beyond the cultures' own homes.

faction.title: Powers
faction.blurb: Pacts, crowns, councils and the people who work against them.

faith.title: Faiths
faith.blurb: What the peoples of Valdren pray to, sing to and swear by.

beast.title: Bestiary
beast.blurb: What waits in the Hollows and on the roads between them.

hollow.title: Hollows
hollow.blurb: The dungeons: wounds where the Underflame breaks through.

race.title: Peoples
race.blurb: The six peoples of Valdren. Every one of them can play every role.

culture.title: Cultures
culture.blurb: Where a hero was raised: three cultures for every people.

heritage.title: Heritage
heritage.blurb: The sagas, gifts and kinship each people passes down.

class.title: Callings
class.blurb: The seven classes, and the orders and traditions behind them.

path.title: Paths
path.blurb: The two ways each calling can be walked, chosen at level 10.

origin.title: The Twelve Signs
origin.blurb: The Origins: the sky-sign a hero was born under, and the way of life that follows it.

backstory.title: Backstories
backstory.blurb: What a hero was known for as a child, and the circle that knew them.

answer.title: Life story
answer.blurb: Notes on the moments of a hero's life.
